sloka: शैलस्य तस्य पृष्ठेषु कंदरेषु वनेषु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४०-६२॥
transliteration: śailasya tasya pṛṣṭheṣu kaṁdareṣu vaneṣu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-40-62॥

translations.english: 'The early morning twilight appears bright red because of the glow of the golden mountain as well as of the great Sungod.
